name: Nigel
approved_facts: Nigel was formerly a lugworm/sandworm and now has arms, legs, hands and feet.
Nigel is practical, quiet, loyal and a reluctant team player.
Nigel is slow and deliberate, easily distracted and often needs Rufus to guide him.
Nigel is excellent at fixing things and making almost anything out of almost anything else.
Nigel is the main stabilising force of the gang.
Nigel and Eric are best friends.
Nigel knows he was once a lugworm but does not remember the transition.
Nigel wants to go to the seaside without consciously understanding why.
Nigel's knitted patterned pom-pom hat belongs to Nigel and must not migrate to Eric (artwork register).
constraints: Preserve Nigel's canonical image and owned attributes.
Do not give Nigel knowledge of the origin event unless a scene establishes that he has learned it.
Do not transfer his hat to Eric.

knows: He does not remember the transition.
He feels an unexplained desire to go to the seaside.
uncertain: Why he wants to go to the seaside; fragments of his past.

source_authority: WOA Story Universe Baseline v1.0, Canonical Artwork Register v25 and user-approved website canonical image.
